empty: No rooms yet. Join or create one in Rocket.Chat and it will appear here.

action.resizeSidebar: Resize sidebar — drag, or double-click to reset

placeholder.noRoomHint: Your conversations are listed on the left.
placeholder.missingHint: It may have been deleted, or your account may no longer be a member. Pick another from the list on the left.

create.title: Create a room
create.channelHint: Anyone on the server can find and join it.
create.privateHint: Only invited people can find it.
create.directHint: A private conversation with one person.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Letters, digits and dashes. No spaces.
create.nameHintSpecialChars: Spaces and punctuation are allowed; the server turns them into dashes.
create.nameInvalid: This server does not allow this name. It must match: {{pattern}}
create.nameTooLong: A room name can be at most {{max}} characters.
create.nameSettingsIntro: Both are Rocket.Chat server settings that an administrator can change:
create.nameSettingsSpecialChars: Admin → Settings → Layout → User Interface → turn on "Allow Special Characters in Room Names". Spaces and punctuation are then accepted, and the server converts them to dashes.
create.nameSettingsUtf8: Admin → Settings → General → UTF8 → widen "UTF8 Channel Names Validation", for example to [0-9a-zA-Z-_.À-ỹ]+ to accept accented letters. This is what a genuinely non-ASCII name needs.
create.nameSettingsAdminOnly: Both apply to the whole server and take effect straight away — reopen this drawer afterwards.
create.membersHint: Optional. They are added when the room is created.
create.encryptedHint: End-to-end encrypted. Messages cannot be searched.
create.broadcastHint: Only owners can post; everyone can reply in threads.
create.notAllowed: This server does not let you create rooms. Ask an administrator for the permission.
create.readOnlyBroadcastHint: A broadcast channel is always read only.
create.readOnlyDeniedHint: You do not have permission to make a room read only.
create.encryptedOffHint: This server has end-to-end encryption switched off.
create.encryptedPrivateOnlyHint: Only private channels can be encrypted.

edit.title: Edit room
edit.archivedHint: Nobody can post until it is unarchived.
edit.makePrivateHint: Only invited people can find it.
edit.announcementHint: Shown at the top of the room for everyone.
edit.makePrivateDeniedHint: You do not have permission to change this room's type.
